title: Cases Undertaken by Public Defender's Office
what_it_is: Cases Undertaken by Public Defender's Office

sections.label: PDO cases and representation
sections.summary: As of September 2023, the PDO has taken up 303 cases to Court, and eligible applicants receive representation from the PDO or CLAS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: As of September 2023, the PDO has taken up 303 cases from applicants and has taken these to Court.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Eligible applicants receive representation from either the PDO or the Criminal Legal Aid Scheme (CLAS).

sections.label: Criminal defence aid assessments
sections.summary: Applications for criminal defence aid undergo means and merits tests, not assessments based on alleged offence nature or applicant's moral reprehensibility.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: But some others face more serious, non-capital charges – unlicensed moneylending, drug trafficking or sexual assault against vulnerable victims and so on.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: We have to ensure that aid is rendered to those who are deserving and each application for criminal defence aid is subjected to means and merits tests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: I am not seeking to set that out; I am using short-hand terms here.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: These assessments are not based on the nature of the alleged offences or the moral reprehensibility of the applicant.

sections.label: Means and merits test
sections.summary: The test is whether the person qualifies under the means test and the merits test.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The test is whether the person qualifies under the means test and the merits test.

sections.label: Aid granted and sentence reduced
sections.summary: Aid was granted after fulfilling means test criteria and PDO assessed merit in the appeal, and the Court of Appeal reduced the sentence by two years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Aid was granted as he had fulfilled the means test criteria and PDO assessed that there was merit to the appeal on the ground that the sentence given by the lower Court was excessive.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The Court of Appeal agreed and his sentence was reduced by two years.

sections.label: Questions on PDO capacity and rejections
sections.summary: The Minister is asked about PDO capacity levels and a breakdown of cases rejected for not satisfying the means or merits test.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The first being, whether the Minister can share a little bit of data about the capacity of the PDO, whether what levels of capacity it is operating at, given that this is a new office?

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: And secondly, whether the Minister can give a breakdown about the cases that the PDO has rejected to take on because they did not satisfy the means test or the merits test, based on the number of applications received?

sections.label: PDO capacity and case load
sections.summary: Today, the PDO is not beyond its capacity and will build up a little bit more as the case load increases.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Today, we are not beyond our capacity and we will build up a little bit more as the case load increases.

sections.label: Rejected cases and capacity
sections.summary: Rejected cases failed the means or merits test, not capacity, and no case was turned away for lack of capacity.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: In terms of the data on the types of cases which have been rejected, what I can say to the Member is that, they have been rejected not because of capacity but because they do not meet our means or merits test.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: If the Member wants more data on that, she can file a question and we will look it up and answer it.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: But no case has been turned away because we said we do not have the capacity.

sections.label: Officer numbers and means test
sections.summary: The Member can file a question on cases failing the means or merits test, and there are about 25 officers this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: If the Member files a question, I can look it up and say how many cases did not qualify under the means or merits test.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: If I am not wrong, I think I have given the numbers that we will build up to.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: This year, we have about 25 officers or so, plus minus, and we can build up as necessary.
